components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; petrol with control shadow and press scale.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand-700, #1a566a); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.05); transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), scale 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-800, #144556); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-500, #2c7e96); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on paper, e.g. print statement.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #16222a; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.05); transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), scale 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f1efea; } .ds-btn-outline:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c7e96; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared field chrome: ring shadow, petrol focus ring with halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #16222a; background: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px rgb(22 34 42 / 0.05); transition: box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(91 104 112 / 0.7); } .ds-input:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #cfcbc0; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #1f6a80, 0 0 0 4px rgb(31 106 128 / 0.14); }

components.description: Rail link on petrol; the active glyph is the only brass.

components.css: .ds-rail { background: #0a2029; padding: 12px; width: 240px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; direction: rtl; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #b4d7e0; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 140ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.11); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-icon { color: #d6a84e; }

narrative.overview:
The product's promise is an owner's net income after expenses and fee, so the interface reads like a clean statement rather than a card dashboard. Warm stone ground (#f6f5f2) carries white surfaces lifted by layered ring-plus-drop shadows; deep petrol (brand-700 for action, brand-950 for the navigation rail) supplies the ink; a single brass accent appears only on the active navigation glyph. Neutrals lean warm and the brand leans cool so the two never merge into one grey-blue; status hues sit far from brand.

Owners and staff share one system. Staff screens run denser (same tokens, tighter rows); owner screens lead with the statement: gross, minus expenses, minus fee, equals net income in a petrol block closed by a double rule, as in a ledger. Arabic RTL with Cairo is a fixed commitment, as are 44px touch targets on phones and reduced-motion respect.

Motion is a single signature: a staged page entrance and a number count-up, both GSAP and both skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone ground, white surfaces, petrol ink; brass only on the active nav glyph.
Depth by layered transparent shadows; borders reserved for structure (dividers, table rules).
Arabic-Indic numerals, tabular figures, money isolated left-to-right.
Status always pairs a dot with tinted ground and darkened same-hue text.
Concentric radii: 16px cards, 12px controls inside them.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass appears on the active nav glyph, and nowhere that carries data. Its rarity is how the rail says "you are here".

rules.name: The Same-Hue Text Rule
rules.body: Tinted status grounds take a darkened text of the same hue (700 step), never grey, never the 500 step.

rules.name: The Warm-vs-Cool Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay warm, brand stays cool; do not introduce blue-grey neutrals.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every figure, table, and live number carries tabular numerals (.num, tables) so counts never jitter.

rules.name: The One Numeral System Rule
rules.body: Digits are Arabic-Indic app-wide, produced by currency() and StatCard; do not mix Latin digits into running Arabic UI.

rules.name: The LTR Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts are rendered through components/ui/Money.tsx (a bdi dir="ltr", true minus U+2212) wherever a sign matters, so the sign sits on the digits' leading edge inside RTL text.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: A surface's outline is its shadow's 1px ring. Use border only for dividers, table rules, and the top bar's lower edge.

rules.name: The Soft-Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for the sticky top bar (md) and the drawer scrim (2px).

dos: Do lift surfaces with the Card / Raised / Control shadows and keep border for dividers and table rules.
Do keep radii concentric: 16px cards, 12px controls, 10px small controls.
Do render amounts through Money and number text through currency() so numerals are Arabic-Indic and signs stay on the digits.
Do pair every status with a dot, a tinted ground, and a 700-step same-hue text.
Do keep touch targets at 44px on phones and add hit-44 to small icon buttons.
Do let leading content on owner pages be the statement (income, expenses, fee, net) before decorative stats.
Do wrap new motion in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and reuse PageEnter and CountUp rather than adding new entrances.
donts: Don't use brass for anything other than the active nav glyph (and the existing soft accent well).
Don't introduce a second typeface or a Latin-digit run inside Arabic UI.
Don't return to the generic blue SaaS card grid: no gradient-tinted stat tiles, no colored figures in StatCard (the tone colors the glyph well only).
Don't convey status by color alone, and don't use the 500-step hue as text on a tinted ground.
Don't stack a border and a ring shadow on the same surface.
Don't change print and PDF surfaces (.no-print, .print-sheet) or role-scoped data behavior as a side effect of visual work.
